title: I'm worried my parent is no longer safe living alone
intro: Wondering whether your parent is still safe on their own is one of the most common — and weightiest — concerns families carry.
reassurance: Asking the question early gives you more options and less crisis.

roadmap.whatsHappeningNow: Safety at home depends on several things at once — mobility, memory, medications, and the home itself.
whatMayComeNext: Risks like falls, fire, or medication errors can escalate.
A single incident can force a rushed decision.
Planning now widens your options later.
changesToWatchFor: Falls, wandering, or unsafe use of appliances
Spoiled food, clutter, or an unmanaged home
howToPrepare: Ask about a home safety review and a falls-risk assessment.
Explore support options (in-home help, check-ins, safety technology).
Discuss preferences with your parent before a crisis forces the issue.
